units: Snh. 56ᵇ אלהים אני לא תְמִירוּנִי I am God, you shall not exchange me (for another god); a. e.—Esp. (with ref. to Lev. XXVII, 33) to substitute a dedicated sacrifice (by which both become sacred property).

<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:1">Tem. I, 1</cite> <he>הכל מְמִירִים</he> (Bab. ed. <he>מְמִירִין</he>) all persons have power to exchange; <he>לא שאדם רשאי להָמִיר … המיר מוּמָר</he> which means not that one is permitted to exchange, but that if one did, the substitute is sacred. Ib. 2ᵃ <he>יורש אינו מֵמִיר</he> an heir cannot exchange his father’s dedication. Ib. 3ᵃ, a. fr. <cite ref="M01203"><he>מְיַמֵּר</he></cite> (Pi. of <cite ref="J00423"><he>יָמַר</he></cite>). Ib. I, 1 (7ᵇ) <he>ממירים את שלהם</he> (Talm. ed. <he>בשלהם</he>) can exchange what belongs to them. Ib. <he>הבכור לא יְמִירֶנּוּ בו</he> (Talm. ed. <he>אין ממירין בו</he>) he (the priest) cannot exchange the first-born animal (although it is his as the priest’s share). Ib. 2 <he>ממירים מן הצאן על וכ׳</he> you can substitute small cattle for large; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="A01335"><he>אֵימוּרִים</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 136:1">Yalk. Gen. 136</cite> <he>אני מֵמִיר אתכם</he> I shall force you to abjure your religion (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>משמיד</he>); v. <cite ref="M00525"><he>מוּמָר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be exchanged, to become sacred (without redeeming the original). Part. מוּמָר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:1">Tem. I, 1</cite>; a. fr., v. supra.
